prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Victoria, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Victoria thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’m hearing some talk that the council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am, though I’m not sure how much truth there is to it. They seem to have enough rules already, so hopefully this is just another rumor."
text: The council is officially cracking down and will start issuing heavy fines for any bins left out after 8am. It’s about time they finally enforced some order in this neighborhood!
